SPHA 501.title: Basic Finance
SPHA 501.description: Fundamental concepts of asset pricing and corporate finance.

SPHA 502.title: Managerial Accounting
SPHA 502.description: Development and use of accounting information for management planning and control, and the development of cost information for financial reports. Same as BAAC_V 550;

SPHA 503.title: Financial Accounting
SPHA 503.description: Financial accounting concepts as they relate to health care administration, including the preparation of external financial reports and financial statement and analysis.

SPHA 510.title: Canadian Health Policy and the Healthcare System
SPHA 510.description: Analysis of topical Canadian health policy issues including an historical overview of the health care system, health care funding, public / private financing, health care personnel and pharmaceutical policy challenges.

SPHA 511.title: Government, Business and Health Care Policy

SPHA 512.title: Indigenous Health and Cultural Safety
SPHA 512.description: Core concepts of Indigenous-specific racism and human rights, cultural safety and how this relates to the practice of health administrators.

SPHA 521.title: Organizational Behavior
SPHA 521.description: The effects of individual and group behaviour on organizational processes and outcomes. The organization as an actor and how it behaves in different types of environments.

SPHA 522.title: Strategic Human Resources Management
SPHA 522.description: Aligning the management of human resources with organizational strategy. Best practices in HR management, as well as the role of health care leaders in effectiveness and efficiency.

SPHA 531.title: Economic Evaluation
SPHA 531.description: Maximizing health benefits from health care budgets.

SPHA 532.title: Health Economics
SPHA 532.description: Economic strengths and weaknesses of current arrangements, and the prospects and objectives of various proposals for reform.

SPHA 533.title: Health Care Priority Setting
SPHA 533.description: Application of priority setting and resource allocation methods to improve health from the perspective of the policy maker, health professional, and patient.

SPHA 542.title: Operations and Logistics
SPHA 542.description: The application of management tools and principles to production and allocation problems.

SPHA 543.title: Information Technology for Management
SPHA 543.description: The role of IT in health care management, the importance of effective IT in a health care setting, and the strategic uses of IT.

SPHA 544.title: Health Information Systems
SPHA 544.description: Information systems in planning and management of health care services provided through single-purpose units, comprehensive clinics and hospitals. Emphasis on computerized systems.

SPHA 551.title: Design and Measurement 1
SPHA 551.description: Basic concepts and methods in Epidemiology.

SPHA 552.title: Design and Measurement 2
SPHA 552.description: Clinical Epidemiology, trials and the evaluation of diagnostic tools and therapeutic interventions.

SPHA 553.title: Program Planning and Evaluation
SPHA 553.description: Basic concepts and principles underlying program planning and evaluation in health services.

SPHA 554.title: Application of Statistics in Management
SPHA 554.description: Data analysis and statistical inference. Applications in assessment of the legitimacy and significance of reports.

SPHA 555.title: Biostatistics
SPHA 555.description: Data collection, numeric and graphic summarization, and elementary statistical analysis. Examples primarily from health sciences.

SPHA 556.title: Social Determinants of Health
SPHA 556.description: Foundations of population health. An overview of research on determinants of health, with an emphasis on the social determinants of health.

SPHA 557.title: Quality of Health Care
SPHA 557.description: Current concepts, methods, and applications in health care quality assessment and improvement.

SPHA 561.title: Strategic Management
SPHA 561.description: Management of multi-faceted organizations; weighting functions, understanding industry and organization-specific effects.

SPHA 563.title: Ethics and Ethical Decision Making in Health Care
SPHA 563.description: Ethical dilemmas in the health care setting. Understanding how Ethical features of the system may contribute to or perpetuate some of these problems.

SPHA 564.title: Leadership and Management Skills
SPHA 564.description: A comprehensive understanding of what it takes to be a credible leader in the health economy. Concepts of leadership through a number of lenses and perspectives, using case studies, group activities and individual assignments.

SPHA 580.title: Selected Topics
SPHA 580.description: Current and emerging trends and issues.

SPHA 581.title: Directed Studies
SPHA 581.description: Opportunity to focus on a selected topic under faculty supervision.

SPHA 590.title: Research Project
SPHA 590.description: Completion of a bounded project within a health agency and under individual faculty supervision. Honours/Pass/Fail.
